notes.title: Update v1.0.25
notes.notes:
v1.0.25

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352507/db1fd2f68f556c49dbc7539124c2e104091c4d62.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Commanders! This update brings a host of enhancements to elevate your strategic experience. 
Here's what's new:
New Supply System: Introducing a dynamic supply mechanic to deepen tactical gameplay. Manage resources wisely to keep your forces in fighting shape!

Improved Balancing: Fine-tuned gameplay mechanics for a fairer, more competitive experience across all factions.

New "Inspect Your Army" Option: Added for each faction, allowing you to review your troops' status and composition with ease.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352507/1192a0415a090872d6ff540f42d1c49c1e2ccdf6.jpg[/img]

Multiple Improvements: Enhanced UI, smoother performance, and refined visuals for a polished experience.

Bug Fixes & Tweaks: Squashed pesky bugs and made minor adjustments to ensure a seamless battlefield.

v1.0.25D- Silent Update - Fixed music not playing properly in some of the maps.

Thank you for your feedback and support. Deploy your strategies and conquer the battlefield!
